headline: Nagoya selects AI consumer-hotline project and presents closed-system workflow
summary: Nagoya City selected a consumer-affairs hotline AI demonstration project, implemented by Core Co., in a 1 September project-decision notice. At an October 22 committee meeting, the city presented a closed-system concept for call transcription, structured case records, prompts for missing information and suggested advice. Selection is established; procurement details, field deployment and measured service outcomes are not. The presentation lists accuracy, knowledge freshness, sensitive-information protection and cost-effectiveness as unresolved issues.
